generated_from: ModelRes articulated-body section of the .model files (reader 0x51e1ad / 0x51a435 / 0x510e5f), node collision volumes (0x545927), game data 20260708/extracted; derived values use the loaders 0x517b34 (joint frames) and 0x4f727a/0x4f6f54/0x4f7145 (shape descriptors)
units: metres, kilograms, degrees for limit angles (the engine multiplies by 0.0174533 at 0xc8c574 when it fills the NxD6JointDesc), radians for projection angle, seconds

conventions.axes: engine space, +Y up, values verbatim from the files (frame note 2026-10-05: this is the space of toolkit GLBs written with --frame mirrored, a mirror image of the real-world pose; the default true-handed GLBs and their .ragdoll.json have x negated and quaternions (x, -y, -z, w), limits unchanged, see docs/RAGDOLL_RIG.md)
conventions.quaternions: xyzw as stored. Engine rule: world = local (x) parentWorld (Hamilton product, local on the left); a vector is rotated as conj(q) v q. To use the quaternions in a standard (q v conj(q)) library take the conjugate, exactly as for the skeleton rest pose
conventions.bone_frame: a body is rigidly attached to its bone: actor pose = bone model-space pose (0x5123d2 with 0x53b605). Shape local_pos/local_quat are in that bone frame
conventions.joint_frames: child_frame and parent_frame are the joint frame expressed in the child / parent bone frame. PhysX D6 axes: X = twist axis (NxJointDesc.localAxis), Y = swing1 axis (localNormal), Z = swing2 axis. actor[0] = parent body, actor[1] = child body (0x5141ee). axes_in_*_bone give the three unit axes already rotated with the engine rule, so they can be used without touching quaternions
conventions.limits: swing limits are symmetric half-angles about the bind pose (cone/pyramid about the twist axis); twist is low..high. motion "locked" removes the axis, "limited" uses the value with a soft limit when spring > 0 (spring N*m/rad, damping N*m*s/rad passed to PhysX unscaled), "free" has no limit. A limited axis with value 0 and spring 0 is effectively locked
conventions.shapes: file = values stored in the model; physx = what the engine hands to PhysX (capsule radius = diameter/2 + 0.025, capsule cylinder height = height_total - diameter (0.001 if <= 0), box half extents = size/2 + 0.025, sphere radius + 0.025; shape skinWidth 0.025). Capsules lie along the shape frame local Y

material.source: pivot sheet of the owning Character node (property pivotsheet_id, fragment data) looked up in /pivotbooks/default.pb

runtime_overrides.solver_iterations: 10 on every ragdoll body (CharacterVisual.command_activate_ragdoll 0x69eac6); the file value 4 is not used for characters
runtime_overrides.movement_type: 0 static in the file; the Character node is set to 1 (kinematic, bodies follow the animated bones) at activation and to 2 (dynamic) when a ragdoll state starts; per body 1/2 for partial ragdoll (AnimationCtrl.PostUpdate 0x5cab6b)
runtime_overrides.joint_motors: enabled on all joints at model change (0x5b33d4); orient motor power and target written per frame while a ragdoll state with BehaviorAnimation is active

body_defaults_not_in_file.mass_distribution: updateMassFromShapes(0, mass): inertia from the shapes at density-uniform distribution scaled to the stored mass

scene.gravity_note: PhysicsWorld node property overrides it; jiggle.md quotes the shipped value (0,-14.82,0)

collision_groups.note: pairs_enabled = [groupA, groupB, 1|0] as set by PhysicsSimulation.command_setup_collision_groups 0x7dffbf; pairs not listed keep the scene default (collide only with the same group, 0x502fda). Groups above 19 are the per-ragdoll unique groups handed out by command_create_unique_ragdoll_collision_group; their rows are set by loops in the same function and were not tabulated.

ragdoll_groups.active ragdoll: unique group (>=20) allocated when the ragdoll state starts

capsule_node.source: CharacterRootTemplate_{Enemy,Rorschach,NiteOwl}.fragment, node MovementPhysics; identical in all three

physx.step_offset: CharacterController step limit, initialised from m_ninitsteplimit = 0.3
physx.slope_limit: cos(slopeLimit degrees); the value is not in the three templates (see report section G)
